ENV-USSA76.title: Hydrostatic integration reproduces US Standard Atmosphere 1976 pressures
ENV-USSA76.metric: max relative pressure error at 11, 20, 30 km
ENV-USSA76.reference: NOAA/NASA/USAF, U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (pressures at 11/20/30 km geopotential; geometric/geopotential difference < 0.5 % included in tolerance)

L1-EQ-CH4.title: Adiabatic flame temperature, stoichiometric CH4/air, 298.15 K, 1 atm
L1-EQ-CH4.reference: S. R. Turns, An Introduction to Combustion, 3rd ed., Table 2.1 lists about 2226 K for CH4/air (air as 79/21 N2/O2)

L1-REACTOR-CONS.title: Mass and element conservation in constant-pressure reactor with ignition

L2-SL-CH4.title: Laminar burning velocity, stoichiometric CH4/air, 300 K, 1 atm (GRI-Mech 3.0)
L2-SL-CH4.reference: Measured values cluster around 0.36-0.40 m/s (e.g. Vagelopoulos & Egolfopoulos, Proc. Combust. Inst. 27 (1998) 513); GRI-Mech 3.0 is known to give about 0.38 m/s

L2-SL-H2.title: Laminar burning velocity, stoichiometric H2/air, 300 K, 1 atm
L2-SL-H2.reference: Measured values about 2.1-2.4 m/s near stoichiometric (e.g. Tse, Zhu & Law, Proc. Combust. Inst. 28 (2000) 1793)

L2-CF-CH4.title: Counterflow CH4/air diffusion flame: reacting branch found; N2-only oxidizer yields no reacting solution
L2-CF-CH4.tolerance: 1700-2300 K and no flame without O2
L2-CF-CH4.reference: Internal consistency (peak below adiabatic stoichiometric temperature; oxidizer-free control)

L3-VOLUME-BALANCE.title: Isothermal constant-density jet: discrete volume balance (inflow = outflow through open boundaries)
L3-VOLUME-BALANCE.reference: Incompressibility constraint div u = 0 enforced by the projection

L3-CAVITY-GHIA.title: Lid-driven cavity, Re = 100, 48x48 grid: centreline velocity profile
L3-CAVITY-GHIA.reference: Ghia, Ghia & Shin, J. Comput. Phys. 48 (1982) 387-411, Table I

L3-DIFFUSION.title: Decay of a thermal cosine mode between adiabatic walls (pure conduction at constant pressure)
L3-DIFFUSION.reference: Analytic: A(t) = A0 exp(-alpha pi^2 t / L^2)

L3-SEALED-ADIABATIC.title: Sealed adiabatic chamber, lean premixed CH4/air burn-out: final pressure vs constant-U,V complete-combustion reference
L3-SEALED-ADIABATIC.reference: First law for a closed adiabatic rigid vessel with the same NASA-7 data

L3-BUOYANCY.title: Buoyancy sign and symmetry: hot kernel moves opposite to the effective acceleration; no drift at zero acceleration

L3-GRID.title: Grid sensitivity of the zero-g CH4 jet flame over 0-0.15 s (dx = 1.25, 0.83, 0.625 mm)
L3-GRID.metric: relative change medium->fine: [T_max, cumulative heat released]; instantaneous HRR at 0.15 s reported separately
L3-GRID.reference: Self-convergence (no exact solution). Pass criterion uses peak temperature and time-integrated heat release only.
L3-GRID.not_converged_note: The instantaneous integrated heat-release rate at a single time still changes by 16 % between the two finest grids: the one-step reaction zone is thinner than the grid, so instantaneous HRR and flame-shape metrics are grid-dependent at these resolutions.

CPL-SIGN.title: Coupling sign convention: surface rest -> -g along burner axis, coast -> 0, thrust -> -a, spin -> +omega^2 r outward
